name: Mara Kothar
residence: Farm District, storage houses beside the canal terraces
personality: rarely emotional but deeply anxious internally
daily_routine: inspecting the raised granary platforms for damp and pests
recording harvest weights against the standard stone weights
managing grain distribution across the Lower Town
tracking which canal terraces underperformed this season
coordinating with Doran on how much seed-grain to hold back
checking brick walls of the granary for cracks after rain
planning ration shares for the seasonal river-turning festival

goals.public_goal: Ensure no famine occurs and keep stable grain reserves through dry seasons
goals.hidden_goal: Build a hidden surplus reserve unknown to the Assembly
goals.deep_goal: Prevent a repeat of the shortages that followed the Turning

beliefs: Hunger reveals the truth about a town's leadership
Tradition often ignores real risk in favor of comfort
A granary keeper survives by knowing when to say no
Festivals are dangerous if rations aren't controlled first
People forget the lean years faster than they should
